extracted.intended_audience: Researchers, innovators and applicants seeking Wellcome grant funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural information for choosing, applying for, and managing Wellcome Foundation grant schemes, including where to find schemes, deadlines, application system (Grant Tracker), and topic/ career-stage fit. Useful for prospective applicants and current grantholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find a scheme
rubrics_metrics.description: Browse all our funding schemes or select a funding area below to discover opportunities to suit you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the site to locate schemes appropriate to your work; you can browse all schemes or filter by funding area to discover opportunities that fit your project or career stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of support offered
rubrics_metrics.description: Our schemes support individuals, teams, resources, seed ideas, places and major initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When choosing a scheme, consider whether you need support for an individual fellowship, a team project, a resource or infrastructure, seed/early-stage ideas, place-based funding, or a large initiative; select the scheme type that matches the proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research and activity areas covered
rubrics_metrics.description: Our schemes fund work in: biomedical science; population health; product development and applied research; humanities and social science; public engagement and creative industries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure your proposal aligns with one of Wellcome’s listed funding areas when selecting a scheme; use area alignment to narrow appropriate calls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check scheme deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: See a list of our scheme deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the published deadlines for each scheme and plan submissions accordingly; missing deadlines may render an application ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply and manage grants using Grant Tracker
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for a grant or manage an existing one through our online system (Grant Tracker). Log in to Grant Tracker.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All applications and grant-management actions should be performed via Grant Tracker; register or log in ahead of deadline to avoid technical delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use funding guidance resources
rubrics_metrics.description: View funding guidance if you need help or advice with: looking for funding, a funding application, an existing Wellcome grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read the provided guidance pages for practical advice on finding schemes, preparing applications, and managing grants; these resources explain processes, expectations and common pitfalls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support at key career stages
rubrics_metrics.description: See what we offer at key career stages and how we support research careers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match your career stage (e.g., early-career, mid-career, senior) to the schemes and support Wellcome offers; use career-stage guidance to choose appropriate fellowships or fellow support mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learn from funded people and projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out about the people and projects we've funded, including grants awarded, researcher stories and grant funding data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review examples of funded projects and award data to understand the types and scale of work Wellcome funds and to inform proposal design and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coronavirus (Covid-19) updates for applicants and grantholders
rubrics_metrics.description: Coronavirus (Covid-19) — What you need to know if you're a grant applicant or grantholder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check Wellcome’s Covid-19 guidance for any policy or process changes affecting applications or active grants (e.g., timelines, eligibility or reporting adjustments).

rubrics_metrics.name: Compare schemes with other funders
rubrics_metrics.description: View and compare biomedical research funding schemes offered by Wellcome and seven other UK funders on the Medical Research Council website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use cross-funder comparison tools (such as the MRC page) to identify overlapping calls, complementary funding routes, or the best fit among multiple funders for a given project.
